title: Unvisited embedded work tape
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota$ embed the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and let $M$ be an $m$-work-tape Turing machine. For any initial tape contents and head positions, output prefix, initial configuration, time $t$, and index $j$ outside the image of $\iota$, the set of positions visited by tape $j$ in the embedded computation through time $t$ is the singleton consisting of its initial head position; consequently, that tape uses exactly one cell.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
Initial contents for each of the $k$ tapes
Initial head positions for each of the $k$ tapes
A tape index $j$ outside the image of the embedding
